description: Add src/config/morning-cards.ts with the MOBILE_MORNING_CARDS flag (unset = off) and a test-account user id allowlist, both parsed with zod.
steps: npx jest --maxWorkers=2 tests/smoke/morning-cards-config.test.ts passes and asserts the flag is false when unset
the same test asserts a listed user id is allowed and an unlisted one is not
grep -rn "process.env\[" src/modules/morning-cards returns no matches

description: Define the three PRD domains (업무 실무, 창업·정부 지원, AI 도구) as constants mapped to existing curation/pool domain labels, reusing src/modules/curation/domain-taxonomy.ts instead of redeclaring.
steps: npx jest --maxWorkers=2 tests/smoke/morning-cards-domains.test.ts passes and asserts exactly three domain keys
the same test asserts every mapped value is a member of CURATION_DOMAINS

description: Record the swipe-code reuse decision in docs/work-orders (frontend/index.html is 127 lines, so the cited lines 6283-6330 do not exist; note what was searched and what is reused).
steps: test -f docs/work-orders/mobile-morning-cards-swipe-reuse.md exits 0
grep -c 'index.html' docs/work-orders/mobile-morning-cards-swipe-reuse.md returns at least 1

description: Add a card-source function in src/modules/morning-cards that reads today's cards for a domain from the existing video_pool and video_pool_domain_tags output, with no YouTube API call.
steps: npx jest --maxWorkers=2 tests/smoke/morning-cards-source.test.ts passes using a mocked db fixture
the test asserts each card has video_id, title, channel_name, published_at, thumbnail_url and reason
grep -rn 'googleapis\|youtube.googleapis' src/modules/morning-cards returns no matches

description: Filter cards to the upload window (current year) and return a shortage marker instead of padding with out-of-window videos.
steps: npx jest --maxWorkers=2 tests/smoke/morning-cards-source.test.ts passes a case where out-of-window fixtures are excluded
the same test asserts an empty domain returns zero cards and shortage true

description: Add a pure function that builds the short 'why it was picked' reason text from existing pool fields (domain tag source, relevance score, upload date).
steps: npx jest --maxWorkers=2 tests/smoke/morning-cards-reason.test.ts passes
the test asserts the reason is non-empty and under a named max length constant

description: Add the raw SQL DDL and Prisma model for a morning_card_judgments table (user_id, video_id, domain, verdict, reason_tags, shown_position, created_at) with no transcript column.
steps: test -f prisma/migrations/morning-cards/001_morning_card_judgments.sql exits 0
grep -ci 'transcript' prisma/migrations/morning-cards/001_morning_card_judgments.sql returns 0
npx prisma validate exits 0

description: Add a judgment repository that validates verdict (useful|skip), reason tags (off-topic, outdated, promotional, repetitive, generic, low-quality) and shown position, then writes one row.
steps: npx jest --maxWorkers=2 tests/smoke/morning-cards-judgment-repo.test.ts passes with a mocked db
the test asserts an unknown verdict or reason tag is rejected and a valid call writes exactly one row

description: Add GET /api/v1/morning-cards?domain= that returns 404 when the flag is off and 403 for accounts not on the test allowlist.
steps: npx jest --maxWorkers=2 tests/smoke/morning-cards-routes.test.ts passes using fastify inject
the test asserts 404 with flag unset, 403 for a non-test user, 200 with cards for a test user

description: Add POST /api/v1/morning-cards/judgments that saves one judgment per swipe for test accounts only.
steps: npx jest --maxWorkers=2 tests/smoke/morning-cards-routes.test.ts passes a case where one POST produces exactly one repository write
the test asserts a non-test user gets 403 and no write happens

description: Add the PC review list endpoint returning today's cards per domain with the saved verdict and reason tags, plus PATCH to set reason tags on a judgment.
steps: npx jest --maxWorkers=2 tests/smoke/morning-cards-review.test.ts passes
the test asserts the list joins verdicts to cards and PATCH rejects unknown reason tags

description: Register the morning-cards routes in src/api/server.ts under the existing api prefix.
steps: grep -n 'morningCardsRoutes' src/api/server.ts returns a match
npm run typecheck exits 0

description: Add frontend API client functions for fetching morning cards, posting a judgment and loading the review list.
steps: cd frontend && npx vitest run src/__tests__/morning-cards-api.test.ts passes with mocked fetch
the test asserts the judgment POST body contains video_id, domain, verdict and shown_position only

description: Add an official YouTube watch/embed URL builder that accepts only valid 11-character video ids.
steps: cd frontend && npx vitest run src/__tests__/morning-cards-youtube-url.test.ts passes
the test asserts an invalid id returns null and a valid id yields a youtube.com URL

description: Add the MorningCard component showing thumbnail, title, channel, upload date and reason, rendering YouTube text as escaped text only.
steps: cd frontend && npx vitest run src/__tests__/morning-card.test.tsx passes and asserts the upload date text is in the document
the same test renders a title containing <script> and asserts no script element is created and the literal text is shown
grep -rn 'dangerouslySetInnerHTML' frontend/src/features/morning-cards returns no matches

description: Add the domain picker component for the three domains.
steps: cd frontend && npx vitest run src/__tests__/morning-cards-domain-picker.test.tsx passes
the test asserts three options render and selecting one calls the change handler with its key

description: Add a swipe gesture hook (pointer events, named distance threshold) that reports right as useful and left as skip, with no undo.
steps: cd frontend && npx vitest run src/__tests__/use-card-swipe.test.ts passes
the test asserts a drag past the threshold to the right yields useful, to the left yields skip, and a short drag yields nothing

description: Add the MorningCardsPage that shows one card at a time, advances on swipe, posts one judgment per swipe with its shown position, and opens the video on tap.
steps: cd frontend && npx vitest run src/__tests__/morning-cards-page.test.tsx passes
the test asserts one swipe advances to the next card and calls the judgment API exactly once with the shown position

description: Add the honest empty state message when a domain has fewer cards than expected, never adding filler cards.
steps: cd frontend && npx vitest run src/__tests__/morning-cards-page.test.tsx passes an empty-domain case
the test asserts the honest message is shown and zero card elements render

description: Register the mobile morning-cards route behind the server flag so it bypasses MobileGateNotice only when enabled.
steps: cd frontend && npx vitest run src/__tests__/morning-cards-route.test.tsx passes
the test asserts the page is not rendered when the status endpoint reports the flag off

description: Add the PC review list page showing per-domain cards with verdict and selectable reason tags.
steps: cd frontend && npx vitest run src/__tests__/morning-cards-review.test.tsx passes
the test asserts each row shows title, channel, upload date, verdict, and selecting a tag calls the PATCH client

description: Add a Playwright spec at 390x844 with mocked API routes that checks a card and upload date are visible, swipe right and left each advance and send one judgment request, and saves screenshots.
steps: cd frontend && npx playwright test tests/morning-cards.spec.ts exits 0
the spec asserts exactly two judgment requests were captured after two swipes

description: Add a Playwright case for an empty domain that checks the honest message and zero card elements.
steps: cd frontend && npx playwright test tests/morning-cards.spec.ts -g empty exits 0
the case asserts the card locator count is 0

description: Turn on MOBILE_MORNING_CARDS and the test-account allowlist for staging only in the staging chart values.
steps: grep -rn 'MOBILE_MORNING_CARDS' charts returns matches only in staging values files
grep -rn 'MOBILE_MORNING_CARDS' charts | grep -ci prod returns 0

description: Run the full backend and frontend checks and confirm test counts did not decrease.
steps: npm run typecheck && npm run lint exits 0
cd frontend && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npx vitest run exits 0
/usr/local/insighta-harness/current/bin/run-jest.sh tests/smoke exits 0
